scope_note: 153 function identities from nine desktop/facet test files. Existing audit dispositions were reused for non-candidates; all six proposed ignored diagnostics and their retained proof were independently rechecked at review_base. Eight file hashes match the frozen audit; owner_tests.rs differs and was inspected at review_base. audit_line is the original frozen-audit line, not a current line number.

tests.name: owner_configuration_and_paths_survive_without_a_cargo_source
tests.reason: Owner lease with nonexistent compiler yields serving config and endpoint but no Cargo capability; no fake source derived from paths.

tests.name: replacement_without_cargo_withdraws_the_old_source_but_keeps_current_owner_context
tests.reason: Replaces source-capable composition with no-Cargo composition; old registry capability is withdrawn while current owner/configuration remains available.

tests.name: cargo_authority_uses_only_the_closed_selection_and_existing_default_cache
tests.reason: Exercises explicit selected Cargo home, default home, ambient HOME and missing configured path; only closed selection/existing cache grants Cargo authority.

tests.name: same_endpoint_replacement_revokes_old_snapshot_and_old_drop_keeps_new_host
tests.reason: Installs replacement composition at same endpoint; old snapshot loses export authority and dropping old lease cannot clear new host.

tests.name: a_dead_host_cannot_export_from_a_retained_composition
tests.reason: Retains composition after host lease dies; configuration export becomes unavailable despite snapshot retaining fields.

tests.name: starting_failed_panicked_lost_and_closed_owners_do_not_export
tests.reason: Walks owner gate through Starting/Failed/Panicked/Lost/Closed and verifies registry capability withdrawn until valid restart and new lease.

tests.name: attached_and_unowned_compositions_do_not_guess_compilers_or_policy
tests.reason: Attached/no local compiler environment cannot export inferred config; producer observations/coverage still require explicit authorized evidence.

tests.name: same_host_reacquisition_requires_a_fresh_certified_root_before_export_resumes
tests.reason: After attachment renewal, old config snapshot loses export until fresh certified root observation completes; same endpoint alone cannot restore authority.

tests.name: a_release_from_the_cargo_cache_is_indexed_by_the_owner_and_its_page_reads_its_real_top_items
tests.reason: Resolves anyhow from installed Cargo cache, indexes it through embedded owner, reads package page through app reader and compares all top-level source declarations against indexed outline.

tests.name: a_release_only_its_archive_holds_is_unpacked_and_indexed_the_same_way
tests.reason: Builds Cargo home containing only verified archive/index checksum, unpacks release into source cache, indexes it through owner and compares real source API names to page outline.

tests.name: a_projects_packages_are_the_releases_its_lockfile_pins_each_found_on_this_machine
tests.reason: Reads real toml_pin Cargo.lock and owner dependency list; checks each release unique, lockfile-pinned and present among actual Cargo build artifacts.

tests.name: a_projects_packages_are_indexed_by_the_owner_and_their_pages_read_their_real_top_items
tests.reason: Indexes a project with one dependency, checks async acquisition stage and exact dependency release, then reads owner package page and compares declarations to crate source.

tests.name: a_multi_module_crates_names_carry_the_file_they_are_declared_in
tests.reason: Builds expected public declarations by source file and compares complete owner outline placements, preserving each multi-module item’s file context.

tests.name: an_owner_reopens_its_workspace_after_indexing_a_crate_whose_docs_link_to_std
tests.reason: Indexes toml_write with std-linked docs, restarts owner from same workspace and verifies package remains indexable/readable with expected names.

tests.name: a_page_is_read_from_the_last_publication_while_the_owner_compiles_another_package
tests.reason: Holds long toml_edit compile on worker while querying already published small crate page and package list; page response completes before compile and old publication remains readable.

tests.name: crash_child
tests.reason: Ignored child-process entry signals when compile begins, then blocks/executes controlled index request so paired crash integration can kill process at exact in-progress point; helper is required by parent test.

tests.name: an_owner_killed_mid_compile_reopens_at_its_last_publication_and_indexes_again
tests.reason: Starts child owner compile, kills it after observed compile start, reopens same workspace and verifies last published package list survives and subsequent compile succeeds.

tests.name: a_package_the_compiler_could_not_finish_still_says_so_after_a_relaunch
tests.reason: For serde_core partial compile, checks partial stage/refusal words persist, relaunch reports same partial limitation and does not fabricate full release listing.

tests.name: a_relaunch_lands_what_the_owner_lists_before_it_lists_the_projects_packages
tests.reason: Records listing and project-package publication order on relaunch; verifies preexisting owner packages land before project dependency list and page search follows current sequence.

tests.name: search_child
tests.reason: Ignored child-process entry emits controlled search result fixture for paired integration, including valid rows and stderr diagnostics; required to isolate subprocess environment.

tests.name: a_search_finds_names_in_every_package_the_library_holds_even_one_the_compiler_could_not_finish
tests.reason: Searches owner-held package corpus, checks exact package identity/name results including partial compiler package and validates malformed/duplicate rows are excluded.

tests.name: every_place_a_use_is_named_at_is_the_name_in_code
tests.reason: Reads compiler reference spans from actual toml source and checks every reported span slices to the named identifier; only counts placed source-backed uses.

tests.name: an_earlier_release_is_read_from_its_own_tree_once_it_is_added
tests.reason: Loads pinned and earlier toml release as distinct trees; adds earlier release and confirms route page key and source names point to earlier tree while original route retains pin.

tests.name: refusal_words_are_kept_and_forgotten_by_release
tests.reason: Persists compiler refusal wording keyed by exact source path, reloads it, then removes release and verifies refusal record forgotten.

tests.name: probe_reopen_after_each_package
tests.reason: Ignored manual per-package restart probe; no pass/fail assertions. Retained asserted test an_owner_reopens_its_workspace_after_indexing_a_crate_whose_docs_link_to_std covers persisted owner restart/read behavior.

tests.name: the_compilers_own_rows_carry_the_file_each_type_is_declared_in
tests.reason: Extracts public type declarations from real cached source and checks compiler-produced outline rows carry matching source file for each type.

tests.name: probe_outline_rows_named
tests.reason: Ignored manual row-name dump with no behavioral oracle. Retained a_multi_module_crates_names_carry_the_file_they_are_declared_in and the_compilers_own_rows_carry_the_file_each_type_is_declared_in assert source names and file placement.

tests.name: a_registry_package_is_named_as_its_manifest_names_it_with_its_version_apart
tests.reason: Creates fake registry source with manifest name/version differing from folder stem; package identity uses manifest name/version and leaves stem-only folder untrusted.

tests.name: probe_module_paths_on_a_real_owner
tests.reason: Ignored manual module-path probe, not an assertion test. Retained a_multi_module_crates_names_carry_the_file_they_are_declared_in checks concrete module/file mapping.

tests.name: probe_registry_roots_on_a_real_owner
tests.reason: Ignored registry-root diagnostic. Retained a_release_only_its_archive_holds_is_unpacked_and_indexed_the_same_way plus active registry tests assert archive-only acquisition and exact source selection/refusal.

tests.name: a_stem_reads_back_as_the_longest_version_suffix
tests.reason: Parses crate stem by longest valid version suffix and rejects traversal/invalid names; preserves canonical Cargo purl including build metadata.

tests.name: toml_lists_every_published_release_and_knows_which_are_on_this_machine
tests.reason: Reads fixture index metadata for all releases and distinguishes versions present in unpacked cache from remote-only entries.

tests.name: a_query_finds_crates_on_this_machine_at_their_newest_release
tests.reason: Offline search finds local crates, selects newest available release, and returns empty on blank or unmatched query.

tests.name: a_tree_is_known_as_its_release_and_a_release_as_its_tree
tests.reason: Roundtrips exact release/tree mapping and verifies resolved tree origin Cargo with canonical path.

tests.name: repeated_release_trees_are_not_chosen_by_directory_order
tests.reason: Creates two same-release trees and requires Ambiguous error listing both, independent of directory ordering.

tests.name: only_a_uniquely_admitted_crates_io_tree_gets_an_unqualified_package_identity
tests.reason: Default crates.io tree gets unqualified purl only when unique; custom index remains source-qualified.

tests.name: duplicate_index_metadata_is_ambiguous_before_a_download_is_considered
tests.reason: Duplicate metadata produces Ambiguous date/yanked facts even when archive exists; downloaded bytes cannot mask metadata ambiguity.

tests.name: an_explicit_source_root_selects_the_matching_registry_metadata
tests.reason: Explicit selected source root matches its own index metadata, date/yanked facts, and archive checksum rather than another index.

tests.name: an_archive_unpacks_to_exactly_the_files_cargo_unpacked
tests.reason: Downloads fixture archive only after checksum verification, extracts expected Cargo files, resolves package identity and compares unpacked result.

tests.name: an_app_cache_is_rechecked_against_its_extracted_source_bytes
tests.reason: Mutates existing extracted tree after archive resolution; availability rechecks bytes and falls back to Download rather than trusting cached directory.

tests.name: an_archive_that_is_not_the_published_one_is_refused
tests.reason: Supplies archive bytes inconsistent with published checksum; unpack refuses and avoids accepting resulting tree.

tests.name: an_archive_without_an_effective_index_checksum_is_not_read
tests.reason: Archive lacking effective index checksum is rejected before bytes are consumed/unpacked.

tests.name: the_boundary_uses_the_resolver_the_edition_implies
tests.reason: Uses edition-resolver fixtures to ensure workspace boundary detection follows actual Cargo resolver semantics for implied edition.

tests.name: every_use_the_toml_upgrade_touches_is_only_respelled
tests.reason: Verifies four exact call sites are semantically unchanged, user impact remains zero, and summary words/count match per-use lens.

tests.name: map_insert_is_a_real_change_marked_where_it_differs
tests.reason: Pins before/after plain signatures and exact old/new changed subtrees, preserving shared return wording and punctuation.

tests.name: deserializer_new_changes_is_deprecated_and_can_now_fail_once_each
tests.reason: Separates changed fallible constructor from deprecated constructor row and checks the rendered failure phrase and marks.

tests.name: the_value_page_shows_one_row_per_item_not_per_re_export
tests.reason: Ensures re-export aliases collapse to one API row and both root and nested paths produce equal lens model.

tests.name: smallvec_1_16_0_to_1_16_1_changes_nothing
tests.reason: Checks no diff, impact, rows or affected uses and exact no-change summary for adjacent release versions.

tests.name: a_release_without_local_source_is_said_so_without_claiming_its_date_is_known
tests.reason: A date-only release is explicitly SourceUnavailable; API lens must not claim comparison or show rows.

tests.name: a_local_release_without_the_exact_diff_is_not_called_absent_or_unchanged
tests.reason: Removes the exact pair diff while retaining local source and verifies both summary and lens report DiffUnavailable, not no changes.

tests.name: ambiguous_and_unverified_sources_are_not_collapsed_to_missing_or_available
tests.reason: Mutates identical release fixture through ambiguous and unverified states and requires distinct statuses/diagnostic wording.

tests.name: going_back_reads_as_going_back
tests.reason: Checks older target version gets backward-direction heading while retaining a valid comparison.

tests.name: the_toml_upgrade_counts_each_item_once
tests.reason: Locks aggregate change counts and guards both re-export deduplication and same-tail distinct trait items; also checks local binding-only edit is respelled.

tests.name: a_parameter_rename_alone_is_respelled_not_breaking
tests.reason: Parameter-only rename has identical plain words, no old/new highlights and does not inflate breaking/use-impact counts.

tests.name: the_comb_touches_only_releases_that_really_change_your_code
tests.reason: No-op release changes yield no touched releases; injected real Map::insert impact selects only its exact target release.

tests.name: debug_respelled_dump
tests.reason: Ignored filtered inventory dump that ends in unconditional panic; it has no success oracle. Active neighboring tests assert exact TOML upgrade respelling/count and parameter-rename behavior.

tests.name: arrows_and_words_select_shape_search
tests.reason: Uses arrow and natural-language query forms against shape search, asserting both select the same intended shape-query behavior.

tests.name: named_search_accepts_a_package_prefix_and_caches_the_same_result
tests.reason: Queries a package-qualified name twice; checks prefix resolution and that repeated lookup returns the cached same result object.

tests.name: shape_inputs_are_unordered_and_overloads_fold
tests.reason: Permutes shape inputs and overload declarations; verifies input order does not alter query semantics and overloads fold into one result.

tests.name: rust_wrappers_match_plain_words_and_optional_answers_rank_first
tests.reason: Compares Rust wrapper names with plain-language forms and checks optional-result answers rank before weaker alternatives.

tests.name: a_concrete_value_matches_its_derived_external_or_written_traits
tests.reason: Constructs a concrete value with external and explicitly written trait evidence; confirms only those evidence paths satisfy capability matching.

tests.name: the_road_consumes_your_value_and_folds_calls_into_type_places
tests.reason: Builds a multi-call conversion from the supplied value and checks calls fold into the appropriate type-place road.

tests.name: only_intermediate_optional_calls_are_unwrapped
tests.reason: Uses optional outputs at intermediate versus terminal positions; only intermediate optionals may be unwrapped into a continuing road.

tests.name: variants_are_places_but_never_hollow_method_detours
tests.reason: Provides enum variants and method-like detours; verifies variants can be places but hollow getters/methods cannot create false roads.

tests.name: constructor_getter_echoes_and_identity_views_are_not_roads
tests.reason: Combines constructors, getters, echoes, and identity views; rejects paths that merely return the original value or expose an identity view.

tests.name: plain_values_alone_and_four_calls_get_no_road
tests.reason: Asserts plain values alone do not form a road and a four-call chain exceeds the allowed call limit.

tests.name: a_side_input_that_only_your_value_can_make_is_not_opaque
tests.reason: Creates a side input that only the initial supplied value can manufacture; confirms it is not treated as an independently available opaque input.

tests.name: constellation_is_bounded_and_membership_is_cached
tests.reason: Queries a bounded constellation repeatedly and checks membership is cached without exceeding the configured result bound.

tests.name: pinned_recipe_fixture_has_deterministic_cached_queries
tests.reason: Runs pinned recipe queries repeatedly and verifies deterministic cached answers for fixed fixture data.

tests.name: generic_associated_outputs_never_match_unrelated_same_named_types
tests.reason: Creates unrelated nominal types with identical final names and confirms generic associated outputs do not unify by spelling alone.

tests.name: prepared_discovery_is_send_and_reconstructs_identical_answers
tests.reason: Moves prepared discovery across a Send boundary and reconstructs it; results must be identical to direct preparation.

tests.name: variants_can_start_a_real_three_call_conversion
tests.reason: Builds a three-call conversion starting at a variant and checks the variant is an actual usable starting place.

tests.name: a_trait_can_carry_your_value_along_the_spine
tests.reason: Carries the supplied value through a trait-constrained spine and verifies the value remains available to later steps.

tests.name: tuples_and_rust_or_plain_maps_use_the_shared_key_vocabulary
tests.reason: Compares tuple, Rust-map, and plain-map inputs to ensure they share key vocabulary without accepting unrelated key forms.

tests.name: full_world_startup_and_first_input_cost
tests.reason: Keep for now: cache identity is asserted, but printed whole-world timings have no calibrated bound. A replacement requires a measured full-world surface baseline and review; deletion is not established.

tests.name: generated_graph_permutations_preserve_the_same_semantic_roads
tests.reason: Generates graph insertion permutations and checks semantic roads remain identical, guarding order-dependent traversal.

tests.name: generated_irrelevant_producers_do_not_change_best_answers
tests.reason: Adds generated irrelevant producers and verifies best answers remain unchanged, preventing unrelated nodes from perturbing ranking.

tests.name: generated_chains_consume_the_input_never_cycle_and_can_build_every_side_input
tests.reason: Generates chains with consumption, cycles, and side-input requirements; confirms inputs are consumed once, cycles rejected, and every legitimate side input can be built.

tests.name: generated_overload_folding_is_stable_under_node_and_parameter_order
tests.reason: Permutes overload nodes and parameter order and asserts a stable folded result independent of declaration ordering.

tests.name: worker_results_share_indexes_and_enter_the_same_bounded_cache
tests.reason: Runs queries through worker-produced results and verifies indexes are shared and repeated answers enter the bounded cache.

tests.name: every_required_trait_must_hold_for_a_supplied_generic_value
tests.reason: Uses a generic value with multiple required traits and confirms every bound must hold before it can satisfy the input.

tests.name: same_named_traits_in_different_packages_are_distinct_capabilities
tests.reason: Creates same-spelled traits in separate packages and verifies they remain distinct capabilities.

tests.name: qualified_external_capabilities_do_not_collapse_by_final_name
tests.reason: Uses qualified external trait names that share a final segment; checks full qualification prevents accidental collapse.

tests.name: generated_input_assignment_matches_exhaustive_optima_and_is_permutation_invariant
tests.reason: Compares generated assignment choices against exhaustive optima and permuted input ordering, validating both best-score selection and deterministic tie behavior.

tests.name: presentation_plain_words_never_erase_additional_generic_requirements
tests.reason: Adds further generic requirements while presenting plain words; verifies presentation aliases cannot erase the additional bounds.

tests.name: a_custom_display_trait_is_not_the_standard_text_capability
tests.reason: Defines a custom Display-like trait and verifies it does not satisfy the standard text capability.

tests.name: an_intermediate_plain_output_cannot_bypass_an_additional_trait_bound
tests.reason: Adds an intermediate plain output under an additional trait bound; verifies the plain result cannot bypass that unmet bound.

tests.name: unmet_generic_bounds_cannot_fabricate_a_side_input
tests.reason: Leaves generic bounds unmet and checks no side-input recipe is fabricated from the incomplete proof.

tests.name: repeated_generic_inputs_must_unify_to_one_concrete_type
tests.reason: Repeats a generic input position with conflicting concrete types; requires one consistent unification instead of independent per-position matches.

tests.name: erased_nominal_arguments_never_prove_inputs_outputs_or_side_recipes
tests.reason: Erases nominal generic arguments and checks the erased representation cannot prove inputs, outputs, or side-input recipes.

tests.name: proof_status_tracks_preserved_generic_unknown_and_erased_representations
tests.reason: Compares preserved generic, unknown, and erased forms and verifies proof status follows representation certainty.

tests.name: qualified_nominal_types_must_agree_with_the_retained_node_identity
tests.reason: Uses qualified nominal types with conflicting retained node identity and confirms the mismatch is rejected.

tests.name: custom_canonical_constructor_names_do_not_inherit_standard_type_proofs
tests.reason: Uses a custom constructor whose canonical name resembles a standard type; verifies spelling does not grant standard type proofs.

tests.name: nominal_nodes_cannot_be_mistaken_for_heuristic_generic_keys
tests.reason: Creates nominal nodes with generic-looking keys and ensures nominal identity is not mistaken for heuristic structural evidence.

tests.name: generated_erased_arguments_remain_unproved_under_structural_composition
tests.reason: Generates erased arguments through structural composition and verifies uncertainty remains unproved through the composed path.

tests.name: erased_constructor_inputs_cannot_supply_chain_riders
tests.reason: Uses erased constructor inputs as potential chain riders and confirms they cannot supply a later step without identity proof.

tests.name: relative_trait_paths_are_scoped_to_their_package_and_module
tests.reason: Resolves relative trait paths from distinct packages/modules and verifies scope prevents cross-module capability matches.

tests.name: generic_declarations_do_not_prove_conditional_instance_capabilities
tests.reason: Creates a generic wrapper whose trait implementation is conditional; the wrapper constructor/name alone must not prove capability, while the concrete unbounded Wrapper query remains discoverable.

tests.name: unrepresented_hasher_allocator_and_error_arguments_cannot_claim_type_identity
tests.reason: Uses generic types with unrepresented hasher/allocator/error parameters; verifies those arguments cannot establish nominal identity or create false list/text roads, while valid fallible conversion remains.

tests.name: semantic_names_and_package_items_are_shared_prepared_action_indexes
tests.reason: Compares prepared, attached, and worker discovery instances; semantic-name/package-item indexes must be shared by Arc and return exact Invocation candidates/items.

tests.name: qualified_shape_names_compare_complete_segments_instead_of_substrings
tests.reason: Queries qualified shape words with partial and complete segments; only complete normalized path segments match, not substring coincidences.

tests.name: trait_identity_includes_package_version_and_selected_dependency
tests.reason: Uses same trait identity across package versions and selected dependency contexts; package/version/dependency choice must participate in equality.

tests.name: crate_type_paths_accept_normalized_full_and_short_package_names
tests.reason: Checks normalized full and short package-qualified crate type paths resolve the same consume road.

tests.name: raw_pointer_identity_is_not_owned_value_proof
tests.reason: Uses raw pointer types and raw-pointer-consuming functions; raw ownership cannot satisfy owned Alpha/text proof, while the unsafe name remains searchable.

tests.name: unsafe_calls_are_names_but_not_safe_callable_proofs
tests.reason: Keeps unsafe callable names in name search but excludes them from safe recipe proofs even when their signatures appear compatible.

tests.name: shape_complexity_is_rejected_before_recursive_parsing
tests.reason: Feeds overly nested/large shape syntax and checks rejection occurs before recursive parsing with empty results and bounded cache growth.

tests.name: prepared_focus_facts_preserve_member_callers_and_tours
tests.reason: Compares precomputed focus facts with independently derived used members, capability set, counts, callers, and tour data for every fixture node.

tests.name: explicit_array_queries_do_not_erase_length_identity
tests.reason: Uses arrays with differing element/length identities; explicit array queries preserve length and cannot match list conversions by element type alone.

tests.name: unsupported_callable_ir_is_distinct_from_unknown_and_complete_empty
tests.reason: Distinguishes unsupported callable IR, unknown query evidence, and complete empty results; user-facing messages and ordinary name facts remain available in the right states.

tests.name: pinned_interruption_retargets_then_returns_to_exact_world_with_same_history
tests.reason: Runs a pinned interruption script that retargets focus and returns to World; compares exact settled camera/history across sampled frames and proves neither camera drift nor live motion remains.

tests.name: input_after_idle_really_opens_find_and_returns_to_quiet
tests.reason: Runs leave→Find→query→Escape→leave after idle; verifies real Find opens from input, returns to quiet state, and does not retain scheduled tracks.

tests.name: pinned_scene_has_named_relations_and_stable_identity
tests.reason: Loads the pinned graph fixture and checks 14-node world plus named RelationLabel/from_str nodes and exact stable relation/identity mappings used by the journeys.

tests.name: reduced_weather_lands_without_live_tracks_and_equals_fresh_narrow_light_world
tests.reason: Compares reduced-motion scenario with a fresh narrow/light world at identical dimensions; both land without live tracks and resulting image dimensions/state agree after real Find round-trip.

tests.name: pinned_chain_has_real_receiver_steps_and_preserves_optional_failure
tests.reason: Builds a pinned optional conversion fixture, confirms one real chain path [10,12,13], exact code, and that optional failure remains represented rather than silently flattened.

tests.name: narrow_graph_uses_its_measured_window_origin_and_leaves_room_for_card
tests.reason: Uses offset narrow window and actual focus card bounds; verifies projected graph target uses measured window origin, card stays inside viewport, and graph has room above the card.

tests.name: reach_and_tour_keys_show_the_pinned_content_and_walk_real_stops
tests.reason: Exercises Reach and tour keyboard journeys against pinned nodes, asserting actual reachable set/source and stop sequence, then confirms repeated keys close/reset modes.

tests.name: native_scenarios_preserve_state_picking_and_geometry_across_weather_and_cadence
tests.reason: Runs seven native scenarios across weather/cadence and checks real hover/node IDs, relation packet, chain path/code, reach/tour visibility, finite geometry/text, and quiet tails; requires each scenario-specific observed state.

tests.name: two_same_symbol_moves_without_a_frame_keep_the_real_peek_open
tests.reason: Uses two native pointer moves to same symbol without an intervening frame; confirms real pick remains node 0, delayed peek stays open after intent, and leave clears hover/overlay.

tests.name: parked_pointer_uses_current_prism_geometry_after_resize_and_text_scale
tests.reason: Changes resize/text scale while pointer is parked; pointer coordinates stay fixed but hover slot is recalculated from current prism frame, then leaving clears hover and motion.

tests.name: opening_find_during_focus_flight_and_closing_it_after_arrival_restores_prism
tests.reason: Opens Find mid-flight and closes after arrival in normal/reduced modes; while searching prism frame is absent, then same focused node gathers with its actual return/call rows and final back is quiet.

tests.name: real_native_zoom_and_drag_preserve_world_anchors_in_normal_and_offset_viewports
tests.reason: Runs native wheel zoom and drag in normal and offset viewports; world anchor drift stays below 0.001px, drag changes exact camera translation without width change, zoom reaches expected factor, then settles.

tests.name: input_timing_captures_real_adapter_work_and_resets_after_each_draw
tests.reason: Injects a 6ms synchronous adapter as a canary; timer must report at least 6ms for the routed input and reset event count/max/cpu to zero on next no-input draw.

tests.name: native_focus_card_padding_click_keeps_focus_and_does_not_drag_graph
tests.reason: Clicks measured card padding in wide and narrow/high-scale setups; foreground padding cannot release focus, alter camera, or start motion at each checkpoint.

tests.name: the_same_world_gives_byte_identical_positions
tests.reason: Computes layout twice for same content and compares exact float bits, while a changed world produces a different cache key.

tests.name: no_level_overlaps_on_a_synthetic_world
tests.reason: Asserts no level overlaps in a synthetic world using layout collision oracle.

tests.name: shells_are_evenly_spaced_polygons
tests.reason: Checks each package shell member count, shell/member radial separation, spacing between nested shells, and that parts do not escape method shell.

tests.name: every_hull_contains_its_contents
tests.reason: Runs hull containment oracle over every world layout to ensure all contained nodes/child geometry remain within parent hulls.

tests.name: hulls_are_faceted_not_round
tests.reason: Samples hull polygon turns and requires a measurable facet angle, preventing round/unfaceted hull regression.

tests.name: pagerank_sums_to_one
tests.reason: Checks PageRank vector sums to one and every item has positive mass.

tests.name: the_cache_computes_once_per_content_hash
tests.reason: Requests same content layout twice and asserts Arc pointer identity, proving cache computes/reuses one result.

tests.name: the_real_workspace_lays_out_cleanly
tests.reason: Loads actual workspace graph, checks deterministic repeat layout, normalized PageRank, no overlaps, and hull containment together.

tests.name: zoom_detail_is_continuous_and_its_silhouette_is_the_hit_contract
tests.reason: Sweeps five node kinds across 2,000 zoom increments; checks radius/label-alpha continuity and that every glyph vertex remains inside both painted and hit silhouettes.

tests.name: visible_members_are_pickable_through_the_former_half_alpha_gap
tests.reason: Places two nodes at a controlled 2-unit separation and checks bounds, ordinary picking, and stable picking all switch at the visibility threshold, including the low-alpha transition point.

tests.name: cached_relations_keep_masks_and_exact_mixed_family_counts
tests.reason: Builds a neighborhood with incoming CALLS and outgoing USES/GIVES; asserts exact endpoint/relation/direction tuples and that family counts account for each edge exactly once.

tests.name: visible_bounds_index_matches_brute_force_and_bounds_local_work
tests.reason: Compares the indexed visible-bounds query with brute force over a deterministic layout and verifies the index prunes work outside the queried view.

tests.name: scene_visible_packets_match_occupied_geometry_across_scale_modes
tests.reason: Compares scene packets against occupied geometry in multiple scale modes, so render visibility and spatial occupancy cannot diverge.

tests.name: hover_retention_is_bounded_by_shared_shape_and_nearest_margin
tests.reason: Varies candidate distance and shared glyph shape while hovering; proves retention is limited to the same shape and nearest-margin rule, avoiding sticky selection outside the hit contract.

tests.name: relation_bows_are_finite_monotone_and_have_no_inflection
tests.reason: Samples generated relation bows and asserts finite coordinates, monotonic progress, and no curve inflection, catching unstable geometry before painting.

tests.name: high_fanout_packets_preserve_group_counts_and_query_only_visible_leaves
tests.reason: Uses a high-fanout fixture to retain exact grouped edge counts while proving queries enumerate only visible leaves rather than expanding the whole neighborhood.

tests.name: ambient_levels_do_not_change_when_large_hulls_leave_the_view
tests.reason: Moves large hulls outside the viewport and checks ambient emphasis levels for remaining visible content stay unchanged.

tests.name: animated_hover_reuses_adjacency_and_keeps_the_members_owner_lit
tests.reason: Advances animated hover across frames and verifies cached adjacency reuse while lighting only members owned by the hovered node.

tests.name: projection_and_picking_share_pixels_across_camera_and_view_offsets
tests.reason: Applies camera and view offsets together, then checks projection and picking resolve the same screen pixels across those transforms.

tests.name: measured_foreground_room_preserves_fanout_across_card_placements
tests.reason: Uses measured foreground room and several card placements to confirm the fanout remains represented after layout space is reserved.

tests.name: actual_picking_preserves_pixel_targets_at_every_zoom
tests.reason: Projects targets at each zoom and checks real pick results against pixel target positions, covering zoom-dependent hit accuracy.

tests.name: sparse_picking_agrees_with_geometry_without_duplicate_candidates
tests.reason: Compares sparse-index picking to the geometry oracle and verifies candidates are unique, ruling out duplicate broad-phase hits.

tests.name: cached_hover_curve_bounds_contain_every_sample
tests.reason: Samples the cached hover curve and asserts every point lies inside the reported bounds used for culling.

tests.name: transition_bounds_only_describe_visible_painted_geometry
tests.reason: Checks transition bounds against visible painted geometry only, preventing offscreen or invisible transition content from expanding damage/culling regions.

tests.name: same_seed_same_field
tests.reason: Same seed deterministically reproduces shards and changing seed changes generated field.

tests.name: resizing_keeps_the_lattice
tests.reason: Comparing unchanged top-left region at two canvas sizes requires at least 80% of triangle geometry to remain identical.

tests.name: opacities_stay_in_the_boards_range_and_the_light_comes_from_the_top_left
tests.reason: Checks every shard opacity range, minimum field population, directional brightness/density and sparse but nonzero twinklers.

tests.name: twinkle_peaks_at_three_point_two
tests.reason: Pins amplitude at phase values including quarter/half-wave peak to preserve 3.2× twinkle multiplier.

tests.name: paint_batches_are_few_and_cheap
tests.reason: Across two canvas sizes and 120 phases bounds generated draw paths per frame; timing is diagnostic only, count is stable oracle.

tests.name: field_stats
tests.reason: Ignored statistics-only output of counts/quantiles/area with no assertion. Geometry and paint behavior remain asserted by active field determinism/invariant and bounded-batch tests.
